Floating UI — local popover positioning

Runtime bundle: floating-ui.dom.js
Source packages from the official npm registry:
  @floating-ui/dom   1.8.0
  @floating-ui/core  1.8.0
  @floating-ui/utils 0.2.12

Author: Floating UI contributors
License: MIT (full text in FLOATING-UI-LICENSE.txt)
Repository: https://github.com/floating-ui/floating-ui
Documentation: https://floating-ui.com/docs/computeposition

This local ESM bundle exports only autoUpdate, computePosition, flip, offset
and shift, with their dependencies. It was bundled with esbuild 0.28.2 for
ES2020 browsers. Runtime loading uses local files; no CDN or remote service
is required. The upstream implementation is unchanged; unused exports were
removed by the bundler.

Local chapter integration:
  - Anchored desktop panels use flip and shift to remain inside the viewport.
  - autoUpdate runs only while a panel is open and is cleaned up on close.
  - Mobile uses the chapter's compact bottom panel layout.
  - The chapter owns disclosure, keyboard focus, Escape and click-away logic.
